sdk.title: sdk
sdk.now_foreign: swapped to {0} (not by us — left alone)
sdk.now_unknown_file: an sdk file is there, but it is not nnSdk
sdk.v_not_needed: No sdk swap needed: the game is built on sdk {0}, firmware is {1}.
sdk.v_needed: The game is built on sdk {0}, firmware is {1} — a swap is needed. sdk {2} from the found ones fits.
sdk.v_needed_none: The game is built on sdk {0}, firmware is {1} — a swap is needed, but none of the found sdk fits. Put nnSdk {2} into {3}.
sdk.v_needed_none_any: The game is built on sdk {0}, firmware is {1} — a swap is needed, but none of the found sdk fits. Put an nnSdk not newer than the firmware into {2}.
sdk.v_swapped_ok: Swapped to sdk {0} — it fits firmware {1}. All good.
sdk.v_swapped_too_new: Swapped to sdk {0}, but it is also newer than firmware {1}. Pick another one.
sdk.v_swapped_unknown: There is an sdk file in the game folder, but it is not nnSdk. Check it by hand.
sdk.v_unknown: Could not tell the game sdk or the firmware.
sdk.question: Swap the game's sdk?
sdk.none_found: No sdk found. Put nnSdk files into {0} (or {1}). Any file names.
sdk.details_rule: Identified by file contents (nnSdk + the SDK MW string); file names can be anything. Duplicates from the two folders are merged by ModuleId and sha256.

fixes.title: What the module fixes
fixes.pick_sdk: Choose an sdk to see what the module will fix.
fixes.no_game: The game's code was not read — no forecast.
fixes.summary_none: Nothing to fix: this sdk has everything the game needs.
fixes.st_proxy: the real one is there — the module passes calls to it
fixes.st_vulkan: the game uses Vulkan — graphics are left alone (as in the sdk)
fixes.st_native_stub: a dummy in the sdk, but it is the game's own sdk — the module stays out
fixes.st_no_version: a dummy in the sdk, version unknown — the module stays out
fixes.st_unknown_sdk: the sdk file is not recognised as nnSdk — the module passes calls as is
fixes.note_ldn_set_protocol: ours is a stub: the game starts, local multiplayer will not work
fixes.vk_rule_vulkan: Vulkan rule: the game uses Vulkan ({0}) — graphics are left alone.
fixes.vk_rule_gl: Vulkan rule: a Vulkan game's graphics are left alone. This game uses OpenGL — the module fixes graphics.
fixes.vk_rule_other: Vulkan rule: a Vulkan game's graphics are left alone. This game does not use Vulkan.
fixes.gaps_may_crash: Missing in this sdk (or an empty stub there), and the module cannot supply them yet: the game may fail to start or crash when it reaches them.
fixes.gaps_weak_more: Optional (weak reference): {0} more — usually the game does without them.
fixes.gaps_weak_note: The game refers to them optionally (weak reference). Usually the game checks for such a function itself and does without it, but there is no guarantee.
fixes.gaps_debug_tip: First just launch the game. If it crashes or shows a black screen, tick “Debug build”, install again, launch the game and send “Collect logs to send” to the 4IFIR group on Telegram (t.me/kf4fr).
fixes.gaps_unchecked: Could not check which functions the game will miss in this sdk: the game's own sdk could not be read.
fixes.gaps_details_head: Functions that sdk {0} lacks and the module does not supply:
fixes.gaps_details_note: Under each readable name is the full name from the game's symbol table. For the module to supply a function, it has to be added to the module's fix catalog (nxr_autofix_catalog.h).
fixes.gaps_online_line: These belong to online services ({0}). They do not affect start-up — the game should launch.
fixes.gaps_online_if: If it does not launch, tick “Debug build”, install again, launch the game and send “Collect logs to send” to the 4IFIR group on Telegram (t.me/kf4fr).

about.what: Modifies a game built for a newer firmware so that it runs on yours: removes ZBIC compression, swaps the sdk, adds a module that fills in the missing functions. The same module loads mods without LayeredFS.
about.thanks_lunya: To Lunya (Langegen) — for TorrentShopNX: the game list, names of new games, the game sdk version without keys, Borealis with Cyrillic. Much here is built on that code.
about.thanks_duckbill: To Duckbill, the author of DBI — his romfsex showed how to redirect game files without tying the module to one game.
about.thanks_4ifir: Heartfelt thanks to the 4IFIR community — it keeps me motivated, and it is the best: t.me/kf4fr
about.thanks_others: Borealis (natinusala, xfangfang) · libnx (switchbrew) · Atmosphère · exlaunch · NX-torrent-player

diag.title: Debug report
diag.lead: The debug build of the module writes a report on every game start into the game folder; the last 5 are kept. Y — reload.
diag.other_game: This report is from another game: {0}
diag.truncated: The report is cut: the module stopped writing after the line limit.
diag.raw_cut: … the rest is not shown (the full file is on the card)
diag.s_loaded: The module loaded and writes the report
diag.s_tid: Game id received from the system
diag.s_modules: The module sees the game modules
diag.s_modfolder: Mod folder exists on the card
diag.s_redirect: Redirection worked at least once (opens / attempts / taken from card)
diag.v_not_report: This does not look like an nxredirect report: no header.
diag.v_symbols: Redirection does not work: file functions not found — the game probably has a built-in SDK. Such a game does not suit nxredirect.
diag.v_tid: Redirection does not work: the module got no game id, the mod path cannot be built.
diag.v_mount: Redirection does not work: the card did not mount. main.npdm is probably not patched or is from another game version — install again.
diag.v_modfolder: Redirection does not work: the card is mounted, but the mod folder is missing: {0}. Check the mod files are exactly there.
diag.v_files_missing: The path is right and the mod folder opens, but none of the files the game opens are in files/. Put the mod files at the same paths as in the report (case must match).
diag.v_no_redirect: No redirection happened; the report gives no reasons.
diag.v_works: Redirection works: files are taken from the card.
diag.v_no_opens: The report exists, but the game has not opened files yet — maybe it did not get that far.
diag.g_not_report: This does not look like a graphics report.
diag.g_no_calls: No graphics calls: the game did not reach drawing, or the hooks did not fire.
diag.g_no_suspects: No graphics call is marked as failed. If the screen is black, the cause is elsewhere.
diag.g_suspect: First failed graphics call: {0} (EGL code {1}). This is the main suspect.
diag.none_dir: No reports for this game in {0} or in the card root. Install the game with “Debug build” checked, start it and come back here.
diag.legacy: This is an old-style report from the card root (nxredirect-diag.txt): it may be left over from another game.
